description: Using separate signals or store fields so a change notifies only the readers of that part of the state.
Caching a derived value until its dependencies change; `computed`, NgRx selectors and NGXS selectors all do it.
Running Angular without zone.js; updates are triggered by signals, events and explicit notifications.
Moving from RxJS-based state to signals one feature at a time through `toSignal` and `toObservable` bridges.
